ModMetaData.name: Better Traders Guild
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Overhauls the Traders Guild faction from the Odyssey DLC.
While relations are good you can visit their orbital settlements by shuttle to trade. Each settlement's trader rotates over time, and the Guild will send trade request quests.
A custom map generator builds furnished settlements with a garrison that defends its home, worker mechs, sheltering civilians and a cargo vault you can hack to steal the trade stock. The mod also adds a smuggler's den assault quest and two scenarios.
See the Steam Workshop page for full details.
